source: How each kind of account can be reached: the age-59½ rule for pre-tax and Roth earnings (IRC 72(t)), Roth contributions withdrawable any time, HSA non-medical use penalty-free from 65, 529 restricted to qualified education, a donor-advised fund irrevocable. Liquidity scale after BiggerPockets' Personal Financial Statement: 1 today · 2 within 30 days · 3 within 12 months · 4 can't or won't sell.
confidenceNote: The access ages are statute and stable; the default liquidity per kind is a convention (a brokerage account settles in days, a house takes months) and every asset can override it.
note: Keyed by asset.taxCharacter, with a fallback by asset.category for assets never characterised. `bucket` is the portfolio the 10x Statement files it under. `accessAge` null means no age gate. `basisAccessAge` is for Roth: contributions come out any time, earnings wait for 59½ — the bridge to 59½ counts only the basis. D-066.
